<div class="hero-brand">
  <img src="images/cornell_seal.svg" alt="Cornell University" class="cornell-seal">

<div class="hero-summary">
  <p>Every empirical project begins with data somebody had to find, fetch,
  clean, check, and shape — work your methods courses assume is already done.
  This course teaches it, across the raw material economists now use: messy
  tables, text, documents, images, audio, and maps. AI tools are part of the
  toolkit from early on — and precisely because a model can draft competent
  code in seconds, the skill this course grades is <em>verification</em>:
  knowing whether the result is right. Homework is a single running
  investigation of the January 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, taken through a
  new data family each week; there are no prerequisites.</p>
</div>
